comment: Synthetic store N10-230 (1.2.10 row 40). Device-only notes with vaultAllowed true (p4e-001 user note, p4e-002 agent note with body and refs, p4e-003 mission index entry), one device-only index entry not exported (p4e-004), one device-only note not exported (p4e-005) and one any-model note (p4e-006). p4e-003 vaultReportSha256 is the sha256 of the bytes of ../rel128-obs-c/report.md: a test copies that file to <projectRoot>/docs/2026-10-02_quandel-review/report/report.md for the unchanged-report case and changes a byte for the changed-report case.

items.text: Plimbo reviews always start from the zorvex list.
Nimbard grids are checked twice before the vestrel run.
items.body: The second check uses the quandel order.
